data.one_liner: Automatically generate code for converting Dart classes to and from JSON.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart Build System builders to generate `fromJson` and `toJson` methods for annotated classes. It inspects class annotations and fields to handle serialization boilerplate safely.
use_when: You need to serialize and deserialize JSON data into strongly-typed Dart objects.
You want compile-time safety and better performance compared to manual casting or runtime reflection.
avoid_when: Your project cannot use code generation or build tools.
You prefer writing manual parsing logic or using runtime reflection.
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate for JSON parsing and serialization
Supports custom type converters, enums, and JSON Schema generation
weaknesses: Requires running a code generator (build_runner) during development
Generated files add to your source tree and require regeneration on model changes
data.setup_notes: Add json_annotation to dependencies, and json_serializable and build_runner to dev_dependencies. Run `dart run build_runner build` to generate code.

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want immutable data classes, union types, and built-in copyWith methods alongside JSON serialization.

alternatives.name: pigeon
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are generating strongly-typed platform channel messaging code between Flutter and host platforms rather than standard JSON objects.
